outcome.Summary: Fixed three bugs in page/page.go Get(): TotalPages now uses ceiling division (fixing the exact-multiple case), the end-of-page slice no longer drops the last item, and pages past the end return an empty Items slice instead of panicking (also copying items to honor the no-aliasing doc contract). Added regression tests in page/page_test.go covering all three bugs, empty input, and non-aliasing; verified with `go test ./... -count=1` and `go vet`, both clean.
